## About
Pacific Crest Roofing works out of Gallup Circle in Laguna Hills and installs roofing and skylights throughout Irvine, Orange County and Southern California.
We work with clay tile, composite tile, wood and shake shingles, and slate and other high-end shingles. We can match the style of your home, stay within California fire code on wood and shake roofs, and follow the HOA guidelines many neighborhoods here have to live by.
Customers rate us 4.5 on Google from 20 reviews. If you have a leak, an aging roof, or just want a look before the rainy season, give us a call.

## Services
- Clay tile roofing: Mission, monarch, flat and pan tile to suit a range of home styles.
- Composite tile roofing: Cool/anti-heat shingles, S-type shingles, pan tile and more. Tough, light and lower maintenance.
- Wood and shake shingles: Wood and shake roofs that match the exterior of your home and stay compliant with California fire code.
- Slate and luxury roofing: Installing or repairing custom, slate and other high-end shingle roofs.
- HOA roofing: Repairs and remodels that follow your HOA guidelines.
- Skylights: Installation of standard and tubular skylights.
- Roof inspections: An inspection on your roof before the rainy season begins.

## FAQ
Q: What areas do you work in?
A: We install roofing and skylights throughout Irvine, Orange County and Southern California.

Q: Can you match my HOA guidelines?
A: Yes. We can match HOA guidelines when roofing repairs or remodels are needed.
